Reason_for_Selection: This model was selected because it achieved the strongest overall performance based on ROC-AUC while also considering recall, F1 score, and business interpretability. ROC-AUC is important for separating claim and no-claim cases, while recall helps identify actual claim cases that may represent higher business risk.
Business_Use: The selected model can help SafeDrive Insurance identify policyholders with higher claim risk and support better underwriting, pricing, and risk monitoring decisions.
